title: Do these steps in order, one at a time, and use the exec tool for every script. Step 1: one exec script that runs "ls src" with tools.exec_command and then throws new Error("synthetic failure"). Step 2: one exec script whose first line is // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 300} and that runs "sleep 3; ls src" with tools.exec_command and returns its output with text(); when exec says the script is still running, call wait with its cell_id until it completes. Step 3: one exec script that calls notify("step one"), then runs "cat src/util.py" with tools.exec_command, and returns that output with text(). Step 4: start two exec scripts back to back, each with first line // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 300}; the first runs "sleep 4; echo first" and the second runs "sleep 4; echo second" with tools.exec_command. Start the second one before you call wait on the first. Then call wait on both cells until both finish. Step 5: one exec script with first line // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 300} that runs "sleep 30" with tools.exec_command; when it yields, call wait on its cell with terminate: true. Then reply DONE.
